description: Locked multilingual retrieval corpus for the v1.1.1 deterministic and semantic comparison.

cards.title: Authentication Session Lifecycle
cards.summary: Login tokens, refresh rotation, and logout invalidation.
cards.body: Sessions rotate refresh credentials and revoke tokens during logout.

cards.title: SQLite Runtime Storage
cards.summary: Use an embedded relational database for derived indexes.
cards.body: The local database stores rebuildable indexes without a server process.

cards.title: Hybrid Recall Pipeline
cards.summary: Fuse exact, full text, and graph candidate channels.
cards.body: Candidate generation precedes score fusion and budget packing.

cards.title: Graph Edge Expansion
cards.summary: Traverse relationships from ranked seed cards.
cards.body: Related cards inherit decayed scores with edge provenance.

cards.title: Embedding Trust Boundary
cards.summary: Exclude secret and untrusted text before provider invocation.
cards.body: Sensitive card content must never cross the embedding provider boundary.

cards.title: Incremental Index Rebuild
cards.summary: Refresh changed cards while preserving unchanged index rows.
cards.body: Content hashes select changed cards for incremental indexing.

cards.title: Semantic Model Setup Command
cards.summary: Download and enable the local model only after confirmation.
cards.body: The setup command displays model revision, cache path, and download size.

cards.title: Offline Deterministic Fallback
cards.summary: Continue with deterministic retrieval when semantic data is unavailable.
cards.body: Missing models or indexes degrade safely without network access.

cards.title: Heading Aware Chunking
cards.summary: Split Markdown sections into stable bounded passages.
cards.body: Chunk identifiers combine card ID, heading path, ordinal, and content hash.

cards.title: Normalized Vector BLOB Storage
cards.summary: Persist normalized float vectors as derived SQLite binary values.
cards.body: Cosine scanning reads fixed dimension vectors from local BLOB columns.

cards.title: Local Model Cache Integrity
cards.summary: Validate pinned model files and revision metadata.
cards.body: Checksums detect missing or incompatible cached model artifacts.

cards.title: Exact Match Rank Authority
cards.summary: Exact IDs, titles, and paths remain authoritative over similarity.
cards.body: Semantic candidates supplement rather than displace exact retrieval signals.

cards.title: Disabled Path Latency Budget
cards.summary: Keep non-semantic ask latency within ten percent of baseline.
cards.body: Measure warm p50 and p95 query latency independently.

cards.title: Corrupted Index Recovery
cards.summary: Detect invalid cache or database state and provide rebuild guidance.
cards.body: Recovery leaves Markdown cards untouched and replaces derived data.

cards.title: Deleted Card Vector Cleanup
cards.summary: Remove derived chunks when their parent card disappears.
cards.body: Incremental indexing deletes orphaned vectors for removed cards.

cards.title: Transactional Index Replacement
cards.summary: Build replacement semantic data atomically before committing it.
cards.body: Interrupted indexing rolls back instead of exposing partial vectors.

cards.title: Semantic Manifest Validation
cards.summary: Validate semantic configuration while preserving old manifests.
cards.body: Configuration errors are actionable and legacy defaults remain compatible.

cards.title: Semantic Explain Provenance
cards.summary: Report similarity, chunk heading, model revision, and parent card.
cards.body: Explain output retains both semantic evidence and graph edge provenance.

cards.title: Multilingual E5 Small Model
cards.summary: Use the pinned multilingual E5 encoder for Chinese and English queries.
cards.body: Queries use the query prefix and passages use the passage prefix.

cards.title: Markdown Cards Are Source of Truth
cards.summary: Vectors and SQLite rows are disposable derived state.
cards.body: Clearing semantic data never edits canonical Markdown memory cards.
